author: felicepantaleo
body:
This PR moves `PerfTools/Perfetto` from the `core` category to the `heterogeneous` category.

The review of cms-sw/cmssw#51271 asks for this change. The package depends directly on `HeterogeneousCore/AlpakaInterface` and on CUDA/CUPTI, and nothing in the package requires `core`.
title: Move PerfTools/Perfetto from core to heterogeneous
